item.title: JK to Orc Heidan ~Aku Buta Oni ni Ryougyaku Sareta Seijo Gakuen~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Blue Gale Light
  • 発売日: 2012-12-28
  • スコア: 5.84/10 (42 人評価)
  • 日本語名: JKとオーク兵団 ～悪豚鬼に凌虐された聖女学園～
  • 英語名: JK to Orc Heidan Aku Buta Oni ni Ryougyaku Sareta Seijo Gakuen

あらすじ

Deep in a forest there existed an old European-style building made of brick. It was an all-girls’ school attended only by girls from good families.

One day the school was covered by a mysterious thick fog caused by an earthquake. Orc soldiers emerged from the ominous fog.

– On a holiday granted by god –

item.description:

  • 日本語名: JKとエロリーマン2～姪っ子JKをもう一人ラブホに連れ込んで、さらにヤリたい放題～
  • 英語名: JK to Eroriman 2 Meikko JK o Mou Hitori Loveho ni Tsurekonde, Sara ni Yaritai Houdai

あらすじ

The protagonist is a middle-aged, single salaryman.

He’s been having secret hotel dates with his niece, Mifuyu.

Once, after parting ways with Mifuyu, he’s ambushed by another niece, Mana.

“Give Mifuyu back!”

Mana had heard from her mother (the protagonist’s sister) that her uncle was a “hopeless loser,” so she couldn’t understand why Mifuyu liked him.

  • 英語名: JK to Inkou Kyoushi SP Wataru Seken wa Ero Kyoushi Bakari

あらすじ

The protagonist is a 41-year-old teacher who pays for sex as a hobby. He’s obsessed with high school girls.

item.description:

  • 英語名: JK to Inkou Kyoushi 6 Love Love Couple Netori Hen

あらすじ

The protagonist, a teacher named Yamada Takashi, felt bitter about the couples flirting around the school. Among the students, there was a couple rumored to be the best: a serious and refreshing boy and a pure and lovely girl. Takashi harbored immoral desires towards that girl, which grew day by day. One day, under the guise of supervision, he brought her back to the school at night. During a casual chat while inspecting her belongings, he learned that she hadn’t even kissed her boyfriend yet.

item.description:

  • 英語名: JK to Inkou Kyoushi 5 Shakkin Shimai Hen

あらすじ

The protagonist is a Japanese history teacher at a private school.

One day, he gets a call from his uncle, who happens to be a loan shark.

Apparently, the parents of two famously beautiful sisters—students at the school—have gone bankrupt.

The uncle suggests sending the girls into the sex trade to pay off their massive debt. Hearing this, the protagonist hatches a plan.

あらすじ

Takumi Araida has been married for 3 years. He loves his wife, but he feels troubled that their married life has become monotonous.

One day, a married couple moved to the apartment next door. Surprisingly the wife was Ryouko Nakajima, Takumi’s classmate in middle school, and her husband happens to be Takumi’s wife’s acquaintance. In celebration of their reunion with old acquaintances, as well as the Nakajima’s moving into their new residence, the two couples held a party.
